title: Bound FidelityManager registration capacity
objective: Close the source-only bounded-state defect where a caller can configure maxRegisteredEntities to an impractically enormous finite integer and thereby remove the project-owned registration envelope, without changing F0-F4 policy or claiming engine evidence.
acceptance: maxRegisteredEntities remains configurable with the existing 4096 default but has an explicit project-owned finite upper ceiling
the ceiling is a defensive memory/state envelope rather than a claimed device-performance budget
exact maximum is accepted and maximum plus one is rejected before manager state is constructed or policy evaluation proceeds
malformed scalar and metatable no-execute behavior from retained PR #385 remains intact
registration-capacity rejection accounting semantics for actual full managers remain unchanged
F0-F4 selection, hysteresis, transition atomicity, WorldEntity identity, Roblox representation, networking, and persistence contracts do not change
pure deterministic regressions cover the exact maximum and maximum-plus-one constructor/pure-policy boundaries
Docs/FIDELITY_MANAGER.md distinguishes the project-owned safety ceiling from later measured runtime profile tuning
canonical CI, live pr-ownership after the separately owned trusted-history recovery, and fresh independent exact-head review are required before integration
no Roblox Studio, viewport, contact, or two-client evidence is claimed
